0022600025.text: The Washington Wizards (4-3, 1st in the Southeast, 6th in the East, on a two-game win streak) visit the Atlanta Hawks (4-4, 2nd in the Southeast and 0.5 games back, 7th in the East, on a one-game win streak) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C matchup. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, and Washington lost 1-3 to Atlanta in 2025-26, including a 126-96 loss in Atlanta on February 26, 2026. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle), Jock Landale (hip), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), with Asa Newell listed as day-to-day with a toe injury and a game-time decision.
